condition: Using df.at[row, col] = list to put a list into a single cell raises "ValueError: Must have equal len keys and value when setting with an iterable" when the column doesn't exist yet or isn't object dtype.
workaround: Create the column first or cast it to object dtype before assigning, e.g. df["C"] = pd.Series() or df["A"] = df["A"].astype(object), then use df.at.
